fullContentHtml:
UPSC CPF Assistant Commandant 2024 Reserve List & Marks – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the reserve list for the post of CAPF Assistant Commandant (CPF AC). This recruitment was released for 506 posts. Applications for the UPSC CPF AC Recruitment 2024 were accepted from April 26, 2024, to May 14, 2024. The Interview examination is going to be conducted on 04 April 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their reserve list from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 April 2024
  • Last Date : 14 May 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 May 2024
  • Correction Date : 15-21 May 2024
  • Exam Date : 04 August 2024
  • Admit Card Available : 26 July 2024
  • Result Available : 24 September 2024
  • Interview Schedule Available : 04 April 2025
  • Phase-II Interview Schedule Released : 09 May 2025
  • Final Result : 09 May 2025
  • Reserve List : 12 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/- (Exempted)

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

UPSC CPF Assistant Commandant 2024 Reserve List & Marks is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
